name: Narvar
label: Narvar Hub Orders API v1 (enterprise)
description: Enterprise/partner-gated. Default host api.narvar.com/api/v1 overridable via store_host path prefix. Basic account_id:api_key. return_create uses customer returns_path only — unverified public Returns URL.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: order_push | shipment_push | return_create. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: order_number
schema.description: Narvar order number (primary id). Path for shipment_push; nested as order_info.order_number on order_push. Example: SO-1042.

schema.label: returns_path
schema.description: Customer-specific returns path segment for return_create POST /{returns_path}. Not a public URL. Example: returns/v1/orders.

schema.label: order_info
schema.description: Full official order_info object for order_push. Escape hatch when you already have the payload. Prefer the flat order_* fields. Example: {"order_number":"SO-1042","order_date":"2026-10-31"}.

schema.label: order_date
schema.description: Order placement date for order_push (→ order_info.order_date). ISO date. Example: 2026-10-31.

schema.label: order_items
schema.description: Order items for order_push (→ order_info.order_items). Official: [{sku, name, quantity, item_id, item_image}].

schema.label: shipments
schema.description: Shipments array for order_push (→ order_info.shipments) and shipment_push. Official: [{carrier, tracking_number, ship_date, items_info, shipped_to}].

schema.label: billing
schema.description: Billing object for order_push (→ order_info.billing). Official: {amount, tax_amount}.

schema.label: customer
schema.description: Customer object for order_push (→ order_info.customer). Official: {first_name, last_name, email, phone, address}.

schema.label: carrier
schema.description: shipment_push carrier moniker when not wrapping a shipments array. EXACT common: ups | fedex | usps | lasership | ontrac. Prefer shipments.

schema.label: tracking_number
schema.description: shipment_push tracking number when not wrapping a shipments array. Example: 1Z999... Prefer shipments.

schema.label: ship_date
schema.description: shipment_push ship date when not wrapping a shipments array. ISO date. Prefer shipments.

schema.label: items_info
schema.description: shipment_push items when not wrapping a shipments array. Official item shape: [{sku, quantity, item_id}]. Prefer shipments.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: order_push | shipment_push | return_create. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: StudioQuack secret. Auth type basic. Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.
